entries.title: Open problem: Positive-temperature crystalline Gibbs phases for three-dimensional Riesz gases
entries.statement: OPEN PROBLEM from the Codex campaign ledger (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status unsolved). Prove existence of a crystalline Gibbs phase at sufficiently low positive temperature for the three-dimensional Coulomb or Riesz gas in the regimes predicted in the review. Source: Lewin: Coulomb and Riesz gases, the known and the unknown,2022, SectionVI,PDF59-61,66-67.
assumptions: Posed in Lewin: Coulomb and Riesz gases, the known and the unknown,2022
Status as recorded in the campaign ledger on 2026-09-07
